description: Adds the governed-SDD project-local Codex PreToolUse Bash hook for Meridian's advisory-safe large-file read guard.
delta: Add `.codex/hooks.json` to governed-SDD managed files. The hook invokes `meridian hook read-guard --host codex`; it recognizes only documented static read commands, blocks over-budget effective line totals with stderr plus structured deny output, and allows all unknown or failed parses.
verification: a trusted governed-SDD Codex project blocks `cat` of a file over its Read-guard threshold and leaves a chained command unexecuted
